summary: Updates the pinned customer-impact engine to c423a6dcbce5.

api.assessment: This PR updates only the pinned customer-impact engine revision used by CI workflows. Application source, API requests, authentication, authorization, links, storage, flags and processing outputs are unchanged. The new engine lets a promotion pick up gate configuration fields its target does not declare yet, accepts byte-for-byte restores of rewritten historical entries, and accepts combined entries stamped against the promotion target.

rollout: The engine version applies to CI after this update merges. No application deployment, infrastructure apply or SDK publication is implied.
data_effect: Existing and newly processed results are unchanged. No rerun or data migration is required.
